headline: Pakistan fast bowler Haris Rauf was fined 20% of his match fee and given one demerit point, taking his total to five, for a Level 1 ICC Code of Conduct breach during Pakistan's one-wicket tri-series win over England in Lahore on Sunday.

card.desc: Loses 20% match fee, reaches five demerit points.

caption:
Pakistan fast bowler Haris Rauf has been fined 20% of his match fee and handed one demerit point, taking his total to five, for arguing with England's Will Jacks during Sunday's tri-series ODI in Lahore, Dawn reports. England were fined 15% of their match fee for a slow over-rate, Geo News adds.
